title: Thermal safety (spill) switches.
officialText: Thermal safety (spill) switches shall be installed on barometric dampers, draft hoods, draft diverters, and all other appurtenances that allow dilution air into a chimney or gas vent. Thermal safety (spill) switches shall be interlocked with all of the appliances connected to the same chimney or gas vent.
